params.message:
A newsletter is for Afrodidact or for KUBO, and a KUBO one looks like KUBO

The editor asks which newsletter a mail is; an outline sets it, an empty page starts as
Afrodidact, and the list of newsletters shows it. A KUBO mail has the KUBO logo on top and
KUBO in the foot, with under it, small, that KUBO is a project of Afrodidact, its logo and
its address. The line about why someone gets the mail names the right newsletter. Mails
without a choice stay as they were.
